notes.title: Alpha Update 3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Alpha Update 3 for AlterSpace is now live! This update primarily includes modifications to gunplay and combat, but also some QoL fixes/updates. The full patch notes for this update can be found here:

[list]
[*] Starter weapon has now been modified to be fully automatic instead of semi automatic
[*] Increased fire rate for all NPCs
[*] Scrolling through and equipping/dequipping guns can now be done with the mouse wheel
[*] Main Menu splash screen can now be skipped with ESC
[*] Medkits now heal 50hp instead of only 20hp
[*] Consuming food now restores 35 hunger instead of 25
[*] Drinking water now restores 35 thirst instead of 25
[*] Modified scale of certain celestial bodies
[*] Added hover effects to Main Menu buttons
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Minor Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been around a year since the last update, but now we're back! We apologize that we haven't released any updates in such a long time, but it was mainly due to issues with corrupt game files that we had to solve. We've also upgraded the game engine version so that we'll be able to use new methods to adding new features and improving the graphics of the game.

This update is just a small one, containing mostly optimization and some bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Minor graphic optimizations
[*] Decreased mouse sensitivity
[*] Modified scale of some items to be more realistic
[*] General, smaller bug fixes
[/list]

We expect to start rolling out updates more consistently again now, and we hope to be able to release a bigger update within a week or two. If you have encountered any certain bugs as well that you see haven't been fixed in this patch, please let us know in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2371880/discussions/0/3829793451751511374/]discussion forum[/url]!

Enjoy, and we hope to release a bigger update shortly!

notes.title: Alpha Update 3 Release Information
notes.content:
Hi explorers!

Thank you for all your patience with Alpha Update 3!
We now expect to be rolling out this update on the 15th of June, so in exactly one week from now - on Saturday next week.

As mentioned in previous posts, the update will contain graphics optimization for certain planets, improved mouse sensitivity, more realistic scales, air strafing on low gravity planets and more!

In the Community Hub -> Discussions, you can still suggest features and mention all the bugs you've found - and there is a chance that a fix for that bug/that the feature requested still will make it in to this update depending on the size of it.

We hope you will enjoy this update, and we plan on releasing updates on a more regular basis during the summer!

notes.title: Further information about Alpha Update 3
notes.content:
Hello all space travellers!

We wrote in the last announcement that we planned to release the next major alpha update for AlterSpace in the end of this month, but however, due to some technical difficulties that will not be possible. 

We aim on getting this update out as soon as possible. During the development process we've found more bugs that needs to be fixed as well, which we plan on doing before we release the next update. if you've noticed any major - or minor bugs that you would like fixed in the next update, please make a post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2371880/discussions/]community hub[/url].

We do have some more information about the things that will be included in this update however. Except for the already mentioned stuff in the last post we plan on including:

[list]
[*] Fixes of scale of items (especially crates) on planets to be more realistic
[*] Improved character customization
[*] Improved moveability in air, when jumping on low gravity planets
[*] Fixing some issues with audio and music
[*] and more!
[/list]

We will get back with more information about when we'll be able to release this update as soon as we can. 

Thank you for all your support and understanding!

notes.title: Upcoming Alpha Update 3
notes.content:
Hello all AlterSpace fans!

It's been quite some time since the release of AlterSpace, and the last update. Since this, we've gotten a lot of feedback about the game - what we can improve, add and possibly remove.

We have taken all this feedback into consideration and we plan on releasing a larger update by the end of the next month for AlterSpace implementing new features into the game, with also bug fixes and other improvements. 

Some of the planned features to be included in this update are following:

- Improved settings. For example sensitivity customization
- Improved gameplay in general
- A new feature (no further information about this until the update)
- Improved, and more story content.
- Graphical rework  of planets and various locations, and improvements.
- Improvements of gameplay mechanics in general
- and more...

We will release more information about this upcoming update, when it will be released and more detailed information about it soon.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're just releasing a small patch for this week containing a few bug fixes to the game and also some balance changes. In the update next week we will however introduce some new features as well.
This patch contains:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where tritium prices wouldn't appear at first in trading hub
[*] Increased jump height for starter map
[*] Balance changes to the trading system
[*] Balance changes to the food and water system
[*] Fixed bug where disabling music doesn't work
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Alpha Update 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're happy to release the second alpha update for AlterSpace - mostly containing bug fixes, but also preparing for the release of a brand new ship as well as some new features!

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Fixed cursor not appearing on ship selling console
[*] Balance Changes
[*] Fixed not being able to use food and water after warning had appeared
[*] Added text indicator that displays which system you're in, in the Galaxy Map
[*] Pop-up's for loot box content
[*] Fixed bug where no asteroids spawn in a certain system
[*] Fixed having to click twice on inventory items for it to register the click
[*] Added so you can access the settings menu from the pause screen
[*] Preparations for the release of a new ship in the next update
[*] Added option to disable music
[*] Improved visuals in the City
[*] Minor other modifications to star systems
[*] Fixed bug where you can have several menus open at the same time
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Alpha Update 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're happy to release Alpha Update 1, which contains bug fixes and new features for the game.
This update contains:

[list]
[*] Decreased head bob intensity
[*] Added possibility to buy new ships
[*] Added possibility to board and claim other's ships
[*] Decreased food and water decrease speed
[*] Enhanced controller support
[*] Added possibility to scan creatures
[*] Improved sound effects
[*] Added resolution settings
[*] Fixed bug where you're stuck in a landing/landed loop in the Ceteus System
[*] Modified main menu splash screen
[*] Added trading system
[*] Balance Changes
[/list]

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Information about Alpha Update 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've gotten some feedback since the release yesterday, and in a few days we aim to release an update adding some new features.

Here's a list of some of them:

[list]
[*] Adding sensitivity settings for mouse and headbobbing
[*] Decreasing default headbobbing intensity
[*] Adding so you can board ships, loot them, claim them and sell them
[*] More missions, and adding missions you can perform in space
[/list]

if you have any ideas or suggestions on how we can improve AlterSpace, feel free to let us know in our discussion!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
We're happy to finally release the early access version of AlterSpace, today on the 23rd of October.
We expect the game to remain in Early Access for around 1 year, but we can't tell as of right now.
Since the last development update of the game we have additionally added:

[list]
[*] Improved NPC AI
[*] Improved weapon system
[*] Character Selection
[*] Improved scanning system
[*] Improved graphics of certain planets
[/list]

Enjoy, and happy exploring!

- Freeworld Developments

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to unveil the first development update for AlterSpace
New features in this update:

[list]
[*] First person combat
[*] Some bug fixes
[*] UI Rework
[*] A settings menu with graphics options and save settings
[*] Complete remodel of Cyber City
[*] Lip-sync for NPCs
[*] Improved NPC AI
[*] Remodeled weapons
[*] Reworked of Oxygen and Health systems
[/list]

Get ready for the official early access release on October 23rd! 🎉
